name: vr_sales_path_calculator
description: Calculate an honest, assumption-transparent path from price + conversion to $10M net revenue for a Quest VR title. Takes price, estimated reviews (or buyers), Meta commission rate, Quest MAU, and returns copies needed, % of MAU, review factor implied, and a reality flag. Used to ground each game's Commercial Block in math, not optimism.

target_net_usd.description: Net revenue target after store cut (default $10M)

commission_rate.description: Meta store commission (0.30 Horizon Store/App Lab, 0.15 in-headset web)

review_multiplier.description: Curran Games Agency review-to-buyer factor (75 niche / 110 median / 250 casual)

estimated_reviews.description: Expected public review count for this title (if known)
